questions.question: Which Indian leader spoke at a special session in 2025 on “Environment, COP-30 and Global Health”?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Narendra Modi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, a globally recognized leader, has been actively involved in addressing significant global challenges like **environmental sustainability**, **climate change**, and **public health**.
 
• In 2025, during a special session on **“Environment, COP-30, and Global Health”**, he emphasized India’s pivotal role in achieving sustainable development and tackling climate-related issues.
 
• The session was part of the preparations for the **30th Conference of the Parties (COP-30)**, a critical event under the **United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC)**. This event highlights global efforts to combat climate change.
 
• As a proponent of green energy and climate action, PM Modi has launched key initiatives such as the **International Solar Alliance (ISA)** and has been a strong advocate for the use of renewable energy sources.
 
• His leadership in promoting the **Mission LiFE (Lifestyle for Environment)** initiative has gained global recognition, focusing on sustainable living and climate-conscious behaviors. *Hence, this makes Narendra Modi the correct answer.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Conference of the Parties (COP):**

 
 
• **COP** is an annual meeting under the **UNFCCC** where global leaders discuss and negotiate actions to combat **climate change**.
 
• The **COP-30**, scheduled to be held in **2025**, will focus on implementing the **Paris Agreement** and achieving net-zero carbon emissions by 2050.
 
 
 
• **India’s Role in Climate Action:**
 
 
• India is a **significant contributor** to global climate efforts, with ambitious goals like achieving **50% renewable energy capacity** by 2030.
 
• Under PM Modi’s leadership, India is advocating for **global equity** in climate responsibility, emphasizing that developed nations should take greater accountability.
 
• **Example:** India is pioneering efforts in **solar energy** and has launched the **Green Hydrogen Mission** to reduce carbon emissions.
 
 
 
• **Global Health and Environment:**
 
 
• The integration of **health and environment** policies is critical to addressing challenges like **climate-induced diseases** and ensuring the well-being of future generations.
 
• India has also been actively involved in promoting **universal health coverage** and addressing the health impacts of environmental degradation.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key Initiatives by Narendra Modi:**

 
 
• **International Solar Alliance (ISA):** Launched by India and France during COP-21 in 2015 to promote **solar energy** adoption globally.
 
• **Mission LiFE:** A movement introduced to encourage sustainable lifestyle practices and climate-conscious behaviors.
 
• **National Action Plan on Climate Change (NAPCC):** Includes missions like **National Solar Mission** and **National Mission for Enhanced Energy Efficiency** to combat climate change.
 
 
 
• **Global Leadership:**
 
 
• PM Modi’s leadership at global forums like the **G20** and **UN** has been instrumental in shaping international climate policies.
 
• He has consistently advocated for **climate justice**, urging developed countries to contribute more towards climate finance.

questions.question: Khusrau was the son of which Mughal emperor?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Jahangir**__.

__
 
• **Khusrau Mirza** was the eldest **son of the Mughal emperor Jahangir**.** **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Khusrau married the daughter of **Azam Khan Koka.** He had three **sons, Buland Akhtar, Dawar Bakhsh, and Gurshasp**.
 
• **His mother Manbai or Shah Begam **was a Kachhwaha princess and the **daughter of Raja Bhagwant Das**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Akbar** is the greatest of the Mughal emperors of India. He reigned from 1556 to 1605 and extended Mughal power over most of the Indian subcontinent. He was the son of Humayun and the Grandson of Babur.
 
• **Shah Jahan **also called (until 1628) Prince Khurram is the Mughal emperor of India from 1628–58. He built the Taj Mahal.
 
 
• He was the third son of the Mughal emperor Jahangir and the Rajput princess Manati.
 
 
 
• **Jahangir** original named **Nur-ud-din Muhammad Salim** is the Mughal emperor of India from 1605 to 1627.
 
 
• **Prince Salim **was the eldest son of the emperor **Akbar**.
 
 
 
• **Bahadur Shah-I **ascended himself on the throne in **1707** after killing his two brothers and defeating Kam Baksh in the **Battle of Jajau**.
 
• He was the last Mughal who enjoyed all the authority in real terms.
 
• He was popularly known as **Shah Alam I** and called **Shahi-i- Bekhabar** by **Khafi Khan**.

questions.question: Where was the 7th Joint Group of Customs (JGC) Meeting between India and Bhutan held in April 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Munnar, Kerala**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The **7th Joint Group of Customs (JGC) Meeting** between **India** and **Bhutan** was successfully conducted to discuss customs cooperation, trade facilitation, and border management.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Meeting Location and Date:** The meeting was held in **Munnar, Kerala** on **20th–21st April 2026**.
 
• **Leadership:** It was co-chaired by Mr. **Yogendra Garg** (Special Secretary and Member (Customs), CBIC, India) and Mr. **Sonam Jamtsho** (Director General, Department of Revenue and Customs, Bhutan).
 
• **Purpose:** The JGC serves as an institutional framework for resolving bilateral issues relating to **customs cooperation**, **trade facilitation**, and **border management**.
 
• Therefore, the correct location for the 7th JGC Meeting is **Munnar, Kerala**, making Option 3 correct. While the Bhutanese delegation visited **Kochi Port**, the meeting itself was hosted in **Munnar**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Bilateral Trade Overview:** **India** is Bhutan’s largest trading partner, accounting for nearly **80% of Bhutan’s total trade**. Trade exceeded **$1.9 billion in FY 2024–25**, showing a growth of over **46%**.
 
• **Border Infrastructure:** There are **10 notified land customs stations** along the India–Bhutan border. These are located in **West Bengal (6)** and **Assam (4)**.
 
• **Port Visit:** The delegation visited **Kochi Port** to observe maritime operations, including vessel berthing, container handling, and the **Automatic Identification System (AIS)** used in sea patrolling.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• Key priority areas discussed included **Coordinated Border Management (CBM)**, pre-arrival exchange of customs data, and facilitating transit cargo movement via the **Electronic Cargo Tracking System (ECTS)**.
 
• The meeting aimed to ensure secure border management under the **Agreement on Trade, Commerce and Transit** framework.

questions.question: What is the tenure of the Chief Election Commissioner of India?

options.text: 4 years or up to the age of 65 years, whichever is earlier.
3 years or up to the age of 65 years, whichever is earlier.
5 years or up to the age of 65 years, whichever is earlier.
6 years or up to the age of 65 years, whichever is earlier.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**6 years or up to the age of 65 years, whichever is earlier**__.

__
 
• **Chief Election Commissioner has a tenure of 6 years, or up to the age of 65 years, whichever is earlier**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **President appoints **the Chief Election Commissioner, who has a tenure of** 6 years, or up to the age of 65 years**, whichever is earlier.
 
• The Chief Election Commissioner enjoys the **same status and receives the same salary **and perks as available to **Judges of the Supreme Court.**
 
• The Chief Election Commissioner can be **removed **from his office **only in a manner **and on the grounds** prescribed for removal of Judge of the Supreme Court.**
 
• Other Election Commissioners can be removed by the **President **on the recommendation of the **Chief Election Commissioner.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Election Commission has the power of superintendence, direction, and conduct of all elections to Parliament and the State Legislatures.
 
• It also conducts elections in the offices of the President and Vice-President.

questions.question: On 7 November 2025, Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the year-long commemoration of 150 years of the national song “Vande Mataram.” Who composed this iconic song that became a symbol of India’s freedom and national awakening?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Bankim Chandra Chatterji.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **On 7 November 2025, Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the 150-year commemoration of “Vande Mataram” in New Delhi, marking the song’s composition by Bankim Chandra Chatterji in 1875.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **“Vande Mataram”** was composed by **Bankim Chandra Chatterji** around **7 November 1875** on **Akshaya Navami.**
 
• The song first appeared in his novel **Anandamath**, published through the Bengali journal **Bangadarshan.**
 
• It played a major role in the **Indian freedom movement** as a call for unity and devotion to the motherland.
 
• The commemoration launch included the release of a **stamp and coin**, the digital portal **vandemataram150.in**, and a nationwide **mass singing ceremony.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Historical Background**__

 __
 
• Composed: **1875** by **Bankim Chandra Chatterji.**
 
• Published in: **Anandamath** (1882).
 
• Became a national symbol during India’s struggle for independence.
 
 
 
• **Recognition**__
 __
 
• In **1950**, President **Rajendra Prasad** declared that “Vande Mataram” should be accorded **equal honour with the national anthem** “Jana Gana Mana.”
 
 
 
• **150-Year Commemoration (2025–26)**__
 __
 
• Venue: **Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium, New Delhi.**
 
• Key Features: **Commemorative stamp & coin**, **digital participation portal**, **mass singing event**, and **cultural concert “Vande Mataram: Naad Ekam, Roopam Anekam.”**
 
• Commemoration period: **7 Nov 2025 – 7 Nov 2026.**
 
 
 
• **Prime Minister’s Remarks**__
 __
 
• PM Modi described “Vande Mataram” as “a mantra, an energy, a dream, and a resolution.”
 
• He stated it unites all **140 crore Indians** in shared devotion to the motherland.
 
 
 
• **About Bankim Chandra Chatterji**__
 
 
• Born: **1838** in Naihati, Bengal Presidency.
 
• Major Works: **Anandamath**, **Devi Chaudhurani**, **Kapalkundala.**
 
• Known as: **“Sahitya Samrat” (Emperor of Literature)** in Bengali literature.

questions.question: The Indian Air Force commemorated the 25th anniversary of the maiden flight of which indigenous fighter aircraft on 4 January 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Tejas Light Combat Aircraft (LCA)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• The aircraft first flew on 4 January 2001 from HAL Airport, Bengaluru.
 
• The Tejas LCA programme was launched in 1983 to replace ageing IAF fighter aircraft.
 
• The maiden flight was piloted by Wing Commander Rajiv Kothiyal.
 
• It marked India’s entry into the group of nations capable of indigenous supersonic combat aircraft design.
 
• Tejas has evolved from a test platform to a frontline fighter after operational clearances and upgrades.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• In 2025, HAL received an order for 97 Tejas Mk-1A aircraft worth over ₹62,370 crore.
 
• Private firms like VEM Technologies are contributing key assemblies, strengthening indigenous manufacturing.
 
• The programme supports Atmanirbhar Bharat by reducing imports and boosting aerospace employment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The President of India constituted the 16th Finance Commission (FC-16) with Dr. Arvind Panagariya as the Chairman.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. Arvind Panagariya, a Professor at Columbia University and former Vice-Chairman of NITI Aayog, was appointed to lead the Commission.**
 
• The Commission was constituted on 31 December 2023 under Article 280(1) of the Constitution of India.
 
• The mandate of the FC-16 is to provide recommendations for a five-year period starting from 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2031.
 
• Sixteenth Finance Commission (FC-16)__
 __
 
• Chairman - Dr. Arvind Panagariya
 
• Secretary - Shri Ritvik Ranjanam Pandey
 
• Constitutional Article - Article 280
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Article 280__

 __
 
• Mandates the President to constitute a Finance Commission every five years or earlier.
 
• Focuses on the distribution of net proceeds of taxes between the Centre and States.
 
 
 
• Commission Members__
 __
 
• Full-time Members: Smt. Annie George Mathew and Dr. Manoj Panda.
 
• Part-time Members: Dr. Soumya Kanti Ghosh and Shri T. Rabi Sankar.
 
 
 
• Finance Commission Act, 1951__
 
 
• The statutory framework that governs the qualifications and appointment of the Commission members.

questions.question: In which state was the Indian Army's Southern Command exercise, 'Amogh Jwala', conducted in March 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Southern Command of the Indian Army conducted 'Exercise Amogh Jwala' at the Babina Field Firing Ranges in Uttar Pradesh from 6 to 18 March 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tech Integration:** The exercise featured the deployment of **Apache attack helicopters**, fighter aircraft, and mechanized forces.
 
• **Unmanned Systems:** A major focus was placed on **Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS)** and counter-drone technology within a networked architecture.
 
• **Operational Focus:** The 13-day drill tested **integrated air-land manoeuvres**, night-fighting capabilities, and electronic warfare (EW).
 
• **Networked Warfare:** It validated real-time **drone-enabled surveillance** for target acquisition and seamless communication platforms.
 
• **Objective:** To enhance "Battlefield Transparency" and validate force structures for modern, technology-driven warfare.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Babina Field Firing Range__

 
 
• Located near Jhansi in Uttar Pradesh, Babina is one of the premier field firing ranges used by the Indian Army for large-scale armored and mechanized infantry exercises.

questions.question: Which of the following periods has been designated to be commemorated as the Year of India-ROK Friendship announced in April 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2028-29**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• In **April 2026**, the President of the **Republic of Korea (ROK)** conducted a state visit to India, resulting in a series of strategic outcomes and agreements to deepen the **Special Strategic Partnership**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• One of the major announcements made during the visit was the commemoration of the **Year 2028-29** as the **Year of India-ROK Friendship**.
 
• This initiative aims to celebrate the long-standing bilateral ties and promote people-to-people exchanges between the two nations.
 
• Other significant announcements included the launch of an **Economic Security Dialogue** and a **Distinguished Visitors Programme (DVP)**.
 
• The year **2028-29** serves as a milestone target for both countries to further solidify their cultural and diplomatic cooperation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **International Cooperation:** During the visit, the **Republic of Korea** joined the **International Solar Alliance (ISA)** and the **Indo Pacific Oceans Initiative (IPOI)**.
 
• **India's Membership:** In a reciprocal gesture, **India** joined the **Global Green Growth Institute (GGGI)**.
 
• **Economic Ties:** A **Joint Declaration** was signed to resume negotiations for upgrading the **Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA)**.
 
• **Cultural Exchange:** A **Cultural Exchange Programme** was established for the years **2026-2030** to foster cooperation in creative industries and sports.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The visit also led to the establishment of the **India-Korea Digital Bridge** and a **Joint Strategic Vision** for the partnership.
 
• MOUs were signed in diverse fields including **Shipbuilding**, **Maritime Logistics**, **Steel Supply Chain**, and **Science & Technology**.
 
• A framework for cooperation under **Article 6.2 of the Paris Agreement** was also introduced to address climate and environment concerns.
